dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual geometric narrowing from the mid-dorsal region towards the posterior peduncle, resulting in a sharp 2D convergence at the visible terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: The left lateral margin is smooth; the right lateral margin exhibits a distinct protrusion consistent with a pectoral flipper extension.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; characterized by high-intensity reflectance on the left hemisphere and deep shadow on the right hemisphere.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Sharp gradient at the interface between the white dorsal epidermis and the dark aquatic background.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Faint linear, parallel marks visible on the right mid-dorsal plane within the shadowed region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Faint linear epidermal markings on the right mid-dorsal quadrant, consistent with minor rake marks.
